In Every T-G-Apps Game

  • Robot players. Player 1, who sets up the game, is always a human; fill any other seat with a robot. Players on other phones are always human. Every game’s robots play real strategy, not random moves, so a table is ready whenever you are — alone or with friends.
  • Hint system. Not sure what to do? Tap Hint for the play the robots would make and the reason behind it. It is the fastest way to learn a new game or sharpen your strategy.
  • Multi-lingual. Every game, menu and rule book is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Hindi, Indonesian and Vietnamese. Switch languages at any time.
  • Multiphone play. Play together on your own phones: one phone creates a room and shares a six-character code, and friends join from wherever they are. Each phone sees only its own cards.

Casino Games and Local Laws

Our casino games use simulated chips. They do not offer real-money gambling, prizes of real-world value, or cash-out.

Availability varies by location: simulated gambling can be restricted in some countries even when no real money can be won. Local laws and age requirements may apply.

House of Cards and Boneyard feature non-wagering card, dice and tile games for children and adults.

T-G-Apps Casino

T-G-Apps Casino

Casino card games

Eight casino favorites in one app: blackjack, four kinds of poker, and three house-banked table games. Every table plays with simulated chips and a bankroll that carries from hand to hand, so you can practice strategy, try a new game, or just enjoy a night at the tables without spending real money.

Subject to local age restrictions Simulated betting 8 games

21

Blackjack

Classic blackjack against the dealer, with hit, stand, double, split, surrender and insurance, and configurable table rules. The hint shows the basic-strategy play for every hand.

Texas Hold'em

Community-card poker

Two hole cards, five community cards and four betting rounds, in no-limit, pot-limit or fixed-limit play, with blinds and optional antes.

7 Card Draw

Draw poker

Seven private cards, a round of betting, one draw to improve, and the best five cards win.

7 Card Stud

Stud poker

Fixed-limit seven-card stud with antes, a bring-in, and a mix of face-down and face-up cards dealt across five streets.

5 Card Draw

Draw poker

The classic: ante up, bet, draw up to three new cards, bet again and show down.

Baccarat

Punto banco

Bet on the Player, the Banker or a Tie, then watch the cards follow the traditional third-card rules. Six- or eight-deck shoes, with or without the banker commission.

Let It Ride

Table poker against the pay table

Place three equal bets, see three cards, and pull back up to two bets as the two community cards are revealed. A pair of tens or better pays, up to 1,000 to 1 for a royal flush.

Caribbean Stud

Table poker against the dealer

Ante, look at five cards and one dealer card, then fold or raise. The dealer must qualify with ace-king or better, and big hands pay up to 100 to 1 on the raise.

T-G-Apps House of Cards

T-G-Apps House of Cards

Classic card games

Classic card games and a Rummy game menu in one app, from partnership trick-taking, contract play and meld to draw-and-discard, canastas and pegging. Play a quick hand or a full game to the target score, learn the rules as you go, and let the robots fill any empty seat.

Children & Adults No wagering 8 game entries, including the Rummy menu

Hearts

Trick-taking

Pass three cards, then avoid taking hearts and the queen of spades — unless you can take them all and shoot the moon.

Spades

Partnership trick-taking

Bid the tricks you and your partner will take, with spades always trump. Watch your bags, and go nil when the cards are right.

Euchre

Partnership trick-taking

A fast five-card game: order up or call trump, remember the bowers, and take three tricks — or go alone for all five.

Bridge

Contract bridge

Bid to a contract with your partner, then declare or defend with the dummy face up on the table. Played in sets of four deals with rotating vulnerability.

Rummy

Cribbage

Pegging and counting

Discard to the crib, peg to fifteen and thirty-one, then count fifteens, pairs, runs, flushes and nobs in the show. First to 121 wins.

Pinochle

Bidding, meld and tricks

Bid for the right to name trump, show your meld — marriages, runs, pinochles and arounds — then take tricks to win the counters. Partners must make the bid or go set. First team to 1500 wins.

Children & Adults No wagering

Canasta

Partnership draw, meld and canastas

Draw from the stock or take the whole discard pile, meld sets of the same rank with your partner, and build canastas — melds of seven cards. Wild cards help, but they freeze the pile. First team to 5000 wins.

Children & Adults No wagering

Dice Games

Dice game collection

Dice Games is a game-selection menu. Open it to choose YZ or Farkle, each with its own rules. The screenshots below show the menu and each game in it.

Menu of related games

YZ

Dice scorecard strategy

Roll five dice up to three times a turn and choose where to score: the upper section, three and four of a kind, full houses, straights and five of a kind.

Farkle

Push-your-luck dice

Set aside scoring dice and keep rolling to build your turn total — but roll nothing that scores and you farkle and lose it all. First to 10,000 wins.

Dominoes

Domino game collection

Dominoes is a game-selection menu. Open it to choose 42, Block, Draw, Mexican Train, All Fives or Bergen, each with its own rules. The screenshots below show the menu and each game in it.

Menu of related games

Six domino games in one: 42, Block, Draw, Mexican Train, All Fives and Bergen — bid and take tricks in 42; in the others, match the open ends, draw from the boneyard when you are stuck, and be first to play out your hand.

42

Texas trick-taking dominoes

Two teams of two bid on each hand, the high bidder names trumps, and the count tiles are worth extra points. Make your bid to win a mark.

Block

Classic match-the-ends dominoes

Play a tile that matches an open end of the line. There is no drawing: if you cannot play, you pass. Play out your hand first to win the round.

Draw

Match-the-ends dominoes with drawing

Play a tile that matches an open end of the line, and draw from the boneyard until you can. Play out your hand first to win the round.

Mexican Train

Train-building dominoes

Build your own train out from the hub double, or play on the shared Mexican Train. If you cannot play, draw, and your train opens to everyone.

All Fives

Score-by-fives dominoes

Score whenever the open ends of the layout add up to a multiple of five. The first double opens four ways. Reach the target score first to win.

Bergen

Matching-ends scoring dominoes

Score when both ends of the line show the same number, and more when a double makes three. Draw when you cannot play. Reach the target score first to win.

Mahjong

Mahjong game collection

Mahjong is a game-selection menu. Open it to choose Hong Kong, Riichi, Chinese Official, Taiwanese, Sichuan or Solitaire, each with its own rules. The screenshots below show the menu and each game in it.

Menu of related games

Six ways to play: Hong Kong, Riichi, Chinese Official, Taiwanese, Sichuan and Solitaire, with calls for pungs, kongs and chows and each style’s own scoring.

Hong Kong

Classic Cantonese mahjong

Claim pungs, kongs and chows, and go out with four sets and a pair worth at least the minimum faan you choose.

Riichi

Japanese mahjong

Win with a hand that has at least one yaku, declare Riichi when you are one tile away, and add dora for a bigger score.

Chinese Official

Official Chinese rules

A winning hand needs at least 8 points from the long list of official scoring patterns, so plan your hand from the start.

Taiwanese

Sixteen-tile mahjong

Hands hold sixteen tiles, so you go out with five sets and a pair. Score tai for your patterns and reach the minimum you choose.

Sichuan

Three-suit mahjong

Only dots, bamboo and characters, with no chows. Choose a void suit at the start and get rid of it to win.

Solitaire

Tile-matching solitaire

Match free tiles in pairs to clear the turtle, pyramid or fortress layout. Undo or shuffle when you are stuck.
